text:
Ava Patel: Montage weekly account check-in: token usage + throughput snapshot. Quick TL;DR: WoW tokens -8%, QoQ +14%, p95 latency had a short spike last night, spend trending +6% M/M. Posting telemetry and action items below. Please ack.

Marcus Liu: Pushed telemetry numbers: tokens last 7d = 3.10M (prev 3.36M, WoW -7.7%). QoQ total tokens = 9.1M vs 7.97M (+14.1%). Avg throughput (tokens/sec) 1200 -> 1150. p50/p95 latency baseline ~45ms / 220ms; observed spike to 420ms at 03:12 UTC for ~2m. Error rate baseline 0.18% bumped to 0.35% during spike (connection reset errors to dedicated pool). Spend change: +6% M/M driven by bursty ingestion on weekend.

Priya Nair: I queried the node metrics — autoscaler spun a fresh ded node that didn't warm KV cache; cold start + network retries explains p95 spike. I'll pin a temporary fallback policy to hosted for small requests and set a higher min-replicas for that pool. Patch below.

Priya Nair: ```
# routing fallback patch (applied)
route_policy:
  account: montage
  fallback: hosted
  threshold_ms: 300
  min_replicas: 2
  max_burst: 500
```

Priya Nair: Opened infra ticket INFRA-504 to investigate node health and autoscaler timing. ETA for full mitigation (warm start + scaler tweak): ~4h. Will update.

Leo Gomez: I'll coordinate an enablement call with Montage PMs to go over batching best practices and cost controls. Proposed slots: Wed 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT. Also their onboarding note: they launched a nightly batch job last month that causes short token bursts — likely source of QoQ uplift.

Ava Patel: Renewal risk assessment: LOW. Action items: 1) Add cost alert at +8% over baseline, 2) Offer batching/quantization recommendations to reduce per-token spend, 3) Limit burst rate on the route until the batch job is optimized. Marcus/Priya please confirm you'll take items 1/3. I'll do #2 and draft the enablement deck.

Marcus Liu: Confirmed. I'll add cost alert and apply a throttle rule on the montage route. PR reference: #2534.

Priya Nair: Routing policy applied and rolled out at 1829123530. Observability: linked alert INFRA-504 and alert rule cost-alert-montage.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing policy rollout succeeded for montage at 1829123530. Post-rollout telemetry shows p95 returned to baseline by 03:40 UTC; no further spikes recorded in the last 2h.

Ava Patel: :thumbsup: thanks team. I'll update the customer health doc with these notes and ping account owner to confirm enablement slot. Any other risks or asks?

Marcus Liu: No additional anomalies on my side. I'll keep the cost alert live and watch for another 48h.

Priya Nair: I'll follow up once infra responds on INFRA-504 and after we tune the autoscaler.

Ava Patel: Great—closing thread unless new spikes show up.
